# svg-slides set: Nordic Organic (`nordic`)

<!-- GENERATED by bin/draw-slide-sets.js. Edit the script, then re-run it. -->

Nordic organic minimal: warm cream (deep warm charcoal in the dark theme), dark warm-brown Georgia display type at regular weight over a light Arial body, large low-opacity organic blob shapes as texture (pre-computed paths, no filters), three small brown dots as the only accent, at least 40 percent whitespace, a thin bottom rule with a wide-tracked Courier New caption. Not any template's brand.

```
node bin/compose-slide.js title-hero --set nordic --payload payload.json --theme light --out slides/
```

The six slide designs keep the lab set's slot names, kinds, required flags and line counts, so any
payload that fits these budgets composes in every set. Character budgets follow this set's fonts.
Shared conventions, gates and the layout rule: [`../../README.md`](../../README.md).

**References** (composition and palette cues only, no assets copied):
- Scandinavian / Nordic interior and editorial design: warm neutrals, soft organic shapes, generous whitespace, restrained serif type.
- Organic-minimal presentation templates: blob shapes at low opacity, a single muted accent, mono captions.

slots, not literal hues: `--teal` is this set's primary. `--block` / `--on-block` are the
colour-block fill and the text on it (`--ink` / `--on-ink` likewise for a reversed field). Inlined svg-library components pick up the same palette.

## Catalog

| # | Design | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `title-hero` | Cover: cream field, pale organic blob paths at 8 percent, three brown dots, a narrow left text column leaving over 40 percent whitespace, a thin foot rule and a tracked Courier caption. |
| 2 | `section-break` | Section divider: oversized light serif numeral; pale blobs lower right and upper left; eyebrow, two-line title and orientation on the right with plenty of white space. |
| 3 | `big-statement` | Takeaway slide: dots, eyebrow, three flush-left serif lines and an attribution; pale blobs at the top right and bottom left. |
| 4 | `content-two-col` | Content slide: dots, serif heading, body text with a brown bar beside the key point, a pale rounded plate for the graphic and a tracked Courier caption. |
| 5 | `full-diagram` | Figure slide: a large pale rounded plate for the graphic and a narrow one for the takeaway; a faint blob at the lower left. |
| 6 | `closing` | Closing slide: left text column, a large pale blob right, a thin foot rule and a tracked Courier meta line. |
